app.title: JMA3A
app.tagline: Gather the crew. Pick the game. Let's play.
app.subtagline: Moroccan social party games for friends and family — zero install, instant fun
app.howItWorksText: One person hosts and shows the code or QR. Everyone joins on their phone (or pass one phone around). Pick any game and enjoy real-life laughs and banter!

privacy.tapToReveal: Tap to reveal for your eyes only 👀
privacy.keepSecret: Don't let anyone peek at your screen!

dib.name: DIB (The Wolf)
dib.description: Wolves hunt by night, villagers debate by day. Unmask the beasts before the village falls!
dib.seerInstruction: Pick a player to inspect their true nature
dib.witchInstruction: You have one heal potion and one poison potion
dib.discussionPrompt: Who acts suspicious? Debate before casting your votes!

roles.villagerDesc: No supernatural powers, but your sharp intuition is the village's best defense!
roles.wolfDesc: Wake up with your wolf pack each night and eliminate a victim without getting caught!
roles.seerDesc: Inspect one player every night to learn whether they are a werewolf or an innocent!
roles.witchDesc: You hold one healing potion and one poison potion for the entire game. Use them wisely!

dib.winVillage: Village Victory! All werewolves have been eliminated 🎉
dib.winWolves: Wolves Win! The wolves have overrun the village 🐺

intrus.name: L'Intrus (The Intruder)
intrus.tagline: A secret word, an undercover outsider
intrus.description: Everyone has the secret word except one Intruder. Give clever clues to expose them without revealing the secret word!
intrus.giveClue: Give a subtle clue without saying the secret word out loud!
intrus.voteIntruder: Who do you think is the Intruder?
intrus.guessSecret: The Intruder gets a final chance to guess the secret word to steal victory!
intrus.youAreIntrus: You are the Intruder! You have no word — listen carefully and blend in!

chkonFina.name: Chkon Fina? (Who Among Us?)
chkonFina.description: Spicy and hilarious prompts. Vote privately for who fits best and reveal the group's unfiltered verdict!
chkonFina.votePrompt: Vote for the person most likely to:
chkonFina.unanimous: Unanimous! Everyone voted for the same person 🎯

mettelha.name: Mettelha (Act It Out)
mettelha.description: Act out famous expressions, jobs, animals, and objects without making a sound. Clock is ticking!

mamnou3.name: Mamnou3 (Taboo)
mamnou3.tagline: Describe the word, dodge the forbidden
mamnou3.description: Get your team to guess the target word without uttering any of the forbidden words on the card!

missionSirriya.name: Mission Sirriya (Secret Mission)
missionSirriya.tagline: Covert social challenges during the hangout
missionSirriya.description: Each player receives a subtle secret mission to accomplish naturally during the gathering without raising alarms!
missionSirriya.verify: Did they legitimately pull it off?
